latest_release.name: RSS-Bridge 2025-08-05
latest_release.body:
Routine release.

## What's Changed
* [FabBridge] Pull 100% discounted items via Fab API by @thefranke in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4584
* [GoComicsBridge] Fix for JSON being removed by @TReKiE in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4585
* [IdealoBridge] Bypass bot protection by @sysadminstory in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4588
* [GoComicsBridge] Add fallback when link to current comic is missing by @TReKiE in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4589
* [GolemBridge] Add tables to content by @Mynacol in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4613
* [ZeitBridge] Improvements by @Mynacol in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4617
* [NasestrechaBridge] Add bridge  by @pprenghy in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4591
* [WaggaCouncilBridge] Add bridge by @Scrub000 in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4593
* [HeiseBridge] removes language-info-text, add archive.is link for people without subscription by @Tone866 in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4594
* [CentreFranceBridge] Fix parser following website update by @quent1-fr in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4596
* [ExplosmBridge] Error handling by @skrollme in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4600
* [EpicGamesFreeBridge] productSlug can be null; also add a universal future-proof-ish fallback by @arokettu in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4595
* [WarhammerComBridge] Bridge for Warhammer Community blog by @thefranke in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4610
* Update 06_Public_Hosts.md by @chatainsim in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4614
* [GOGBridge] Switch to GOG's REST API. I have tested this locally and it seems to work correctly by @jaydeethree in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4616
* [KemonoBridge] Add search query support by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4620
* [CubariProxyBridge] Replace MangaSee with WeebCentral by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4618
* [AnnasArchiveBridge] Fix book list CSS selector by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4619
* [YouTubeFeedExpanderBridge] More reliable channel icons by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4622
* [ComickBridge] Add new bridge by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4625
* [HumbleBundleBridge] Overhaul to include more information by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4621
* [FanaticalBridge] Create a new bridge by @Phantop in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4624
* [InstituteForTheStudyOfWarBridge] Increase caching time by @SqrtMinusOne in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4626
* [UniverseTodayBridge] Add bridge by @SqrtMinusOne in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4627
* [PepperBridgeAbstract, DealabsBridge, HotUKDealsBridge, MydealsBridge] Adapt RSS bridge to website content update; remove country of origin due to missing data by @sysadminstory in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4634
* [BlueskyBridge] Fix cases for missing reply post context and QoL fix for video loading by @mruac in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4635
* Fix deprecations by @morawskim in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4636
* [HaveIBeenPwnedBridge] Fix item URIs by @VerifiedJoseph in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4638
* [DRKBlutspendeBridge] add offers to content & add caption to images by @User123698745 in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4641
* [PR Testing] fix wrong pr check fail when refactoring code by @User123698745 in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4642
* Mention php extension filter by @SuperSandro2000 in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4608
* fix: dont cache basic auth response by @dvikan in https://github.com/RSS-Bridge/rss-bridge/pull/4644
